From Smooth Operators · Price: only markings and shallow wounds, moved by touch.

Theme Matter and Life

  • 1: 1 action: slide a marking, label or sign from one surface to another within reach. Or slide a shallow wound from you or an ally who is missing Hit Points onto a creature your stand touches: it takes @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[force]] damage (@Check[will|against:stand|basic]{basic Will} save), and the wound's source regains Hit Points equal to the damage taken (up to the Hit Points it's missing). The wound's pain leaves the target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 1} on a failure (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 2} on a critical failure). Once per turn your stand can slide the wound as part of a Strike (1 action) against the creature it hits: the wound opens in the cut for 1d6 extra force damage (2d6 from 5th, 3d6 from 13th) before the save, and the source regains Hit Points equal to that extra damage. On a critical failure the slid wound also bleeds: 1d6 persistent bleed damage.
  • 5: Slide a shallow wound: move persistent bleed damage from an ally to an object. Your stand can slide the wound across two creatures it touches with one action (each saves). Surge, 1 action: slide an ally's condition (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{clumsy}, value 1) onto an adjacent enemy (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will} negates); on a critical failure the slid condition's value is 1 higher.
  • 9: Temporary suture, 1 action: an ally your stand touches regains @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[force]] HP. It doesn't stop persistent bleed. Once per ally per 10 minutes.
  • 13: Slide conditions of value 2, and the surge can split the slid condition between two adjacent enemies (each attempts its own @Check[will|against:stand]{Will} save). A slid wound's bleed is 2d6.
  • 17: Slide a creature's features off: it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{stupefied 2} and can't be recognized for 1 minute (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will} negates).

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
